eligibility_criteria:
Part A:

Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-70 years.
* Confirmed PiZZ AATD diagnosis.
* Blood total AAT level \<11 μM.
* Willing to discontinue augmentation therapy as required by protocol.
* A postbronchodilator FEV1 ≥40% (Ph 1) of predicted or ≥35% (Ph 2) and an FEV1/FVC \<70% at screening (Ph 1 only).
* Evidence of emphysema on chest imaging.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI \>30.
* Lung or liver transplant or on waiting list for lung or liver transplant or status post lung volume reduction.
* Clinical evidence of severe bronchiectasis.
* Significant liver disease as defined in the protocol.
* Active hepatitis A, B or C infection

Part B:

Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-70 years.
* Confirmed PiZZ AATD diagnosis.
* Clinical diagnosis of AATD-related liver disease along with evidence of METAVIR F1, F2, or F3 liver fibrosis.
* A postbronchodilator FEV1 ≥40% (Phase 1) or ≥35% (Phase 2) of predicted at screening.
* FibroScan ≤12 kPa.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Lung or liver transplant or on waiting list for lung or liver transplant or status post lung volume reduction.
* Clinical evidence of severe bronchiectasis.
* Previous diagnosis of liver cirrhosis or complications of cirrhosis.

Part C:

Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-75 years.
* Confirmed PiZZ AATD diagnosis.
* Willing to discontinue augmentation therapy as required by protocol.
* A postbronchodilator FEV1 ≥30% of predicted.
* Evidence of emphysema chest imaging.
* Liver stiffness \<12 kPa.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Lung or liver transplant or on waiting list for lung or liver transplant or status post lung volume reduction.
* Clinical evidence of severe bronchiectasis.
* BMI \>40.
* Known history of liver cirrhosis or complications of cirrhosis.
